description:
Draw JSON as a box-drawing tree: one line per key or array index, with value previews and item counts, so the shape of a payload is readable without counting brackets. Long string values are cut in the preview; the counts stay exact.

Returns: The tree as plain text, drawn with ├─ and └─ branches.
Example input: {"text":"{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"tags\":[\"math\",\"code\"]}"}
On error, includes hint: Any valid JSON document works, including a bare number or string.
name: json_tree
title: JSON tree
